theorem typeI2_le_small {α x δ Q U V : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx2 α x δ a q Q) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hqV : q * V ≤ Q) (hQV : 16 * V ≤ Q) (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 2.5e7 ≤ V) (hUV : U * V ≤ x)
    (hδ : |δ| ≤ 1 / (2 * c₂)) :
    ‖typeI2 α x U V‖ ≤
      x / (2 * q) * minInv c₀ (π * δ) * muBound (min (Q / (2 * V)) U) q * Real.log (V * q) +
        c₀ * (1 / 8 - 1 / (2 * π ^ 2)) / x *
          (U ^ 2 / q * (0.511 * V ^ 2 + V * q * Real.log q) + (2 * U + q) * (0.511 * V ^ 2)) +
        1.0064 * coefUV (cPlus x U V) * (U * V) + 1.0064 * coefQ x q U V (cPlus x U V) * Q :=

note: Lean uses 0.511V² for Σ_{v≤V}Λ(v)v (book 0.5004V²), U²V log q in place of 2UVq log V + 2U²V log V, muBound (2.8·2q/φ(2q)) instead of (4/5)q/φ(q), and no assumption Q ≤ 2UV/e. The old (2.17) lemma sum_vonMangoldt_mul_lt' is gone; sum_vonMangoldt_mul_lt_a17 replaces it.
